_comment2: Controls load-test instrumentation and diagnostic visibility

pipeline_timing._comment: Per-stage latency percentiles for trap processing pipeline (Phase 1 load-test)
pipeline_timing._comment2: Changing these values requires a TrapNinja restart to take effect
pipeline_timing._enabled_comment: Set false to disable timing entirely (reduces hot-path cost to a single boolean check)
pipeline_timing._ring_buffer_size_comment: Samples retained per worker per metric; wraps on overflow (bounded memory)
pipeline_timing._percentiles_comment: Percentiles to compute and export (p50, p95, p99 by default)
